## Core Agency Packages (CAD)
- Spark Drop-In ($500 CAD · 48 Hours): Modular booking widget or landing upgrade
- Flow Sprint ($1,500 CAD · 5–7 Days): Focused high-converting website & booking/payment readiness
- Beat Sprint ($3,000 CAD · 1–2 Weeks · Most Popular): Up to 10 pages, custom brand design system & interactive flows
- Cypher OS ($5,000 CAD · 2–3 Weeks): Full flagship experience, database workflows & custom AI concierge
- Kickoff Terms: 1-Page Project Agreement + 50% deposit via Interac e-Transfer (9lmntstudio@gmail.com) or PayPal Invoice
